title: Occupations to ISCO-08 unit groups
statement: Assign the ISCO-08 unit group (four-digit code) to a job title, as written in a job advertisement, a CV, or an answer to a survey question on the main job.

generation.context: Job titles appear in job advertisements, in CVs, and in answers to the survey question "What is your main job?".
rules: Write each job title as an employer, a jobseeker, or a survey respondent would write it: one to twelve words, sometimes with the seniority, the employer's sector, or a short note on the duties.
Vary the wording: official and informal titles, abbreviations, capitalisation, and titles used in different countries and sectors, including Africa, Asia, Latin America, and Europe.
Do not give the list one pattern: mix short and long forms, and leave most of them without an added qualifier.
Each job title must belong to the label it is given under the definitions above, and must not fit another label from the list better.

reference.source: tabiya/occupation_titles_esco (CC BY 4.0): job titles from hahu.jobs with the ESCO occupation assigned by the job board, mapped to ISCO-08 by the first four digits of the ESCO code. Built by build.py.
